title: Overcoming State Inertia in Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models via Activation Steering
title_zh: 通过 Activation Steering 克服全双工口语语言模型中的状态惯性
abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable seamless speech interaction by allowing models to listen and speak simultaneously, yet the internal mechanism by which they coordinate listening and speaking remains underexplored. We analyze the predictive behavior encoded in FD-SLM hidden representations and find that they exhibit stream-specific predictive patterns: during listening, they preferentially predict the incoming user stream, whereas during speaking, they preferentially predict the model output stream. Building on this observation, we show that FD-SLMs dynamically modulate their internal predictive focus between two states: a generative state aligned with model output generation and a perceptive state aligned with incoming user input. However, this modulation can lag behind abrupt changes in conversational context. During user interruptions, the model remains transiently biased toward the generative state before transitioning into the perceptive state, causing it to miss the beginning of the incoming input. We term this delayed internal transition state inertia. To quantify its downstream impact, we introduce the Zero-Buffer Benchmark (ZBB), a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating immediate interruption comprehension when user speech begins abruptly. We evaluate this setting using response correctness and initial-word occurrence rate (IWOR). Finally, we mitigate state inertia through activation steering with a perception vector, a training-free intervention with little additional computational overhead. Across multiple state-of-the-art FD-SLMs, activation steering substantially improves interruption handling; for example, on PersonaPlex, it improves correctness from 28% to 45% and IWOR from 40% to 72% without any fine-tuning.
abstract_zh: Full-duplex spoken language models（FD-SLMs）支持模型同时听与说，从而实现更自然的语音交互，但其内部如何协调“倾听”和“生成”仍缺乏理解。本文分析 FD-SLM 隐藏表示中的预测行为，发现其具有流特异性预测模式：倾听时更倾向预测用户输入流，发声时更倾向预测模型输出流。基于此，作者指出 FD-SLM 会在两种内部预测焦点之间动态切换：面向模型输出生成的 generative state，以及面向用户输入感知的 perceptive state。然而，当对话上下文突然变化，尤其是用户打断模型时，这种切换会滞后，模型会短暂停留在 generative state，导致漏听用户输入开头。作者将这种延迟内部状态转换称为 state inertia。为量化其影响，论文提出 Zero-Buffer Benchmark（ZBB），用于评估用户语音突然开始时模型的即时打断理解能力，并采用 response correctness 与 initial-word occurrence rate（IWOR）作为指标。最后，作者使用基于 perception vector 的 activation steering 缓解 state inertia，这是一种无需训练、额外计算开销很小的干预方法。在多个先进 FD-SLM 上，该方法显著提升打断处理能力；例如在 PersonaPlex 上，正确率从 28% 提升到 45%，IWOR 从 40% 提升到 72%，且无需 fine-tuning。
key_points_zh: 论文揭示 FD-SLM 内部存在两类预测状态：面向模型发声的 generative state 与面向用户输入的 perceptive state，并会随对话动态切换。
作者发现用户突然打断时，模型状态转换存在滞后，即 state inertia，导致模型仍偏向生成自身输出，从而漏掉用户语音开头。
提出 Zero-Buffer Benchmark（ZBB）诊断无缓冲打断场景下的即时理解能力，并使用 response correctness 和 IWOR 衡量效果。
提出基于 perception vector 的 activation steering 方法，无需训练即可将模型内部状态推向 perceptive state，计算开销较低。
在多个 state-of-the-art FD-SLM 上，该方法显著提升打断理解；PersonaPlex 上正确率由 28% 升至 45%，IWOR 由 40% 升至 72%。

llm_assessment.comment: This work offers a focused and practical intervention for interruption handling in full-duplex speech agents, plus a reusable diagnostic benchmark.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作针对全双工语音智能体的打断处理提出了实用干预方法，并提供了可复用的诊断基准。
